push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 9.2 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.2. That's not a performance, that's a postcard from the top of the mountain.

THE GOOD
+ A brace against JamRock  United, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's a striker's instinct, and you can't teach that at a clinic.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.
+ Your highest rating yet for us, across all 4 matches. Mark the calendar.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (4). That doesn't happen by accident.
+ Team-high 2 tackles won. You can build a whole match on that.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Try it this way: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. You've got this.
- BellyTb1 and you both slipped on defensive work rate. Catch each other: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 2). That needs to look different next time out.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 23 (best was PhogsToffees's 27). Start here: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.

Skills corner: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

buddskees, write this on your hand if you have to: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

I'm gonna go tell my plant about you. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 8.8 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, that 8.8 was a big ol' slice of good football.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ A goal against JamRock  United. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ That link with buddskees was smoother than a Cadillac on new pavement.
+ 8.8: your 5th best match performance of the season. Remember how that felt.
+ Their humans averaged 7.1 to our 8.3; we out-played them man for man. Team wins are the best kind.

THE BAD
- Shot accuracy 25%, down from your usual 89%. Old coach's advice: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Simple as pie: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into. Habits beat highlights.
- 71% passing (17 of 24, down from your usual 79%). Real talk: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. Easy as pie.
- You and buddskees need to sync up on defensive work rate: pass runners off and track them into the box.

Practice pointer: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

Absolute delight to watch. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 7.0
push.body:
A 7.0, PhogsToffees. It's okay to be frustrated. It's not okay to stay frustrated.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ You found buddskees and buddskees found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ Team-high 27 passes attempted. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ Their humans averaged 7.1 to our 8.3; we out-played them man for man. That's what happens when we pull the same rope.
+ 3-2 against JamRock  United. A win's a win, and this was a good one.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Here's the deal: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. That's a promise.
- 0.8 under usual. One fix and you're back on track.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 2 (best was buddskees's 0). Here's the fix: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged.
- Most giveaways on the team: 9 (best was buddskees's 4). That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.

Daily reps: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. The ball doesn't know your rating. Neither should your attitude.

We'll sharpen it at practice. - Coach Lasso
